caption: The drawing depicts a wooden articulated mannequin of a human figure, colored in varying shades of brown to represent the wood grain. The mannequin is composed of segmented parts joined at the shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees, and ankles, each joint shown with a visible fastening mechanism. The head is oval-shaped with marked facial features, including eyes, eyebrows, nose, and mouth. The body is a single piece, while the arms and legs are divided into segments that mimic human anatomy, with curved lines suggesting the texture of wood. The left arm is raised upward at an angle, the right arm is extended outward, the left leg is bent at the knee, and the right leg is straight, giving the impression of motion. The background is plain and uncolored, highlighting the wooden figure as the central subject.
title: Carved Wood Doll
